defect: Every one of the seven transcript-audit tests built its fixture as session/agent.jsonl containing bare top-level {'type': 'tool_use', ...} blocks. The audit discovers transcripts by globbing subagents/*.jsonl and matching the dispatch line naming the lane, and reads accesses out of record['message']['content']. Wrong directory and wrong record shape: the fixtures exercised a path the audit does not have.
family: A4, A5 and A6 were components that worked and were never reached by the path. A7 is the mirror: a path that worked while its tests reached a component that did not exist. Same root cause -- the suite verified pieces in isolation and never once verified that the piece it tested was the piece the lifecycle runs.
fix: Fixtures now write subagents/<team>.jsonl with a real dispatch line, and emit tool calls in the assistant-message shape the audit actually parses. The clean-session test additionally asserts that discovery found the transcript and that all three of its accesses were parsed, because 'clean' is also what an audit that parsed nothing returns.
found_at_phase: field close preparation, before the first sealed read
found_by: organizer, running the full cup50v2 suite after the A6 fix
how_it_surfaced: The suite went red, not green. When discovery became per-lane during the 25,546-finding fix, every fixture started returning no-transcript, and seven tests failed loudly. Had the rewrite been narrower the fixtures could have kept passing on a shape that no longer existed.
standing_change: Every gate that can end a lane now needs a test asserting its fixture is non-degenerate: that the input was found, parsed, and produced the number of observations expected. A pass on an empty parse is indistinguishable from a pass on a clean input, and this edition has now produced that failure twice -- here, and in the readiness fixture whose event lane never fired because the data contained no volume spikes.
title: the transcript audit's tests exercised a record shape the audit never sees
was_the_real_audit_valid: Yes, and this was checked rather than assumed. The audit found a transcript for all twelve lanes -- one or two each -- and produced eight findings across five lanes, which is the same eight adjudicated in T1. A parser that could not read real records would have returned clean with zero findings for all twelve. The gate worked in production; only its tests were phantom.
